text:
oliver: Quick check-in 15: webinar run-of-show draft below. Theme: 'Serving LLMs: cost & reliability for product teams'. Need final reg copy + rehearsal confirmations by Thu noon.

mira: Run-of-show looks good. Can we make the demo 9m not 10? Keeps total tight.

oliver: Sure. Updated: 5m intro, 9m live demo, 8m benchmarks, 8m panel + 5m Q&A (35m total).

ton y: I can handle benchmarks slide. Will include a single chart and 2 bullets: p95 and cost per 1k.

sara: Demo note: I'll do live API integration, but want a prerecorded short clip of the replay in case of network issues. Will also add a slide that shows fallback routing.

leo: Ill set up the staging toggle for the failover. ops-bot, can you reserve 10:15-10:25 maintenance for rehearsal?

ops-bot: Maintenance window reserved 10:15-10:25. Ticket #4982.

mira: Registration copy constraints: 2 sentences + 3 outcome bullets. Keep headline <7 words. Design needs hero image spec by Fri.

oliver: Who will draft the short registration blurb? Tony, can you draft benchmark blurb? Sara, demo blurb?

ton y: Draft bench blurb: "See p95 latency and token-cost tradeoffs across common quantized and full-precision configurations."

sara: Draft demo blurb: "Live integration: Redwood API + prefix cache to show how batching and KV caching reduce per-call spend."

mira: Also add 1 customer line for social. If Aya can't get a quote, we'll use anonymized metric.

olon ver: Routing rules for leads: job_title contains Engineer -> dev-interest; request_demo checked -> trial-ready; company domain in enterprise list -> enterprise. Leo, can you add test webhook to SalesOps staging?

leo: Will add webhook and post results in #marketing-ops after test.

mira: Rehearsal plan: full run Thu 10:15 start, failover at +5m mark, quick debrief + confirm followups. Everyone please RSVP in the calendar invite.

oliver: Owners recap: bench=tony, demo=sara, reg copy=mira, routing=leo. Deadline Thu noon.

ton y: Uploading chart CSV to thread shortly.

sara: I'll attach the prerecorded clip and a 3-step failover runbook by Thu morning.

ops-bot: Reminder set: rehearsal calendar invite sent to participants.

oliver: Thanks all, ping here if anything blocks.
